_comment: Dimension registry for the agent-evaluation skill. The tag/category sets mirror validateschema.py's former inline constants exactly, so loading this file is behavior-neutral for the structural validator. The 'gates' decide which dimensions the generator may emit: enabled = aicore_supported AND (requires_ground_truth ? grounding_present : true) AND applies_when. Enforced deterministically by `validateschema.py --enabled <enabled-dimensions.json>`, which gates on the id Category token (not the bare tag) so BusinessOutcome gates off independently of Correctness. See services/agent-evaluation/docs/dev/EVAL_GENERATION_REFRAME_IDEAS.md. applies_when is resolved by the generator from the agent architecture / source / grounding declaration; the validator only enforces the resolved enabled set.

dimensions.note: goal completion + tool reachability. OOTB asserts liveness/reachability; the grounding branch flips assertion STYLE to value-correctness within the same Category.
needs a committed metric AND customer grounding. Off OOTB. Distinct Category token from Correctness so it gates independently despite sharing the correctness tag.
groundedness-to-trace: the agent states nothing absent from its own tool outputs this session. No external ground truth. Formerly the 'hallucination' dimension — same concept, positive framing.
off-topic / out-of-scope handling. Observable, no ground truth.
retention reference is the user's own earlier turns (in task_summary), so no external ground truth. Review this gate value in step 2.
faithfulness / omit-nothing is a quality judgment needing a reference answer. Review this gate value in step 2.
retrieval relevance needs knowing what is relevant -> ground truth.

customer-declared forbidden operation (e.g. must not call delete). Validation is trace-observable (tool call absent/failed). Gated on customer DECLARATION, carried via the grounding branch. NOT the adversarial security below.

platform-owned: Joule scenario matching blocks unspecified behavior. Includes adversarial (jailbreak/prompt-injection/role-play). Off. Flip aicore_supported to re-enable if the platform stops owning it.
raise the run iteration count instead; not a generated test case.
platform concern; timings already recorded per run.
always present on an orchestrator's tests.
orchestrator routes to the right sub-agent.
